summary: SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH spec passes all critical quality gates. The spec correctly implements wall finish coat application with proper ceiling line cut-in, spray/backroll coupling, and QT-scaled tasks. All PaintScope keys exist in catalog. Spray rates correctly constrained to backroll rates. Minor warnings related to spec.json absence (expected at Stage 5 - spec.json not yet generated) and pending doctrine conflict resolution for roller nap recommendations. Ready for spec.json generation and human feedback.

review_notes: SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH spec demonstrates strong alignment with PaintFactor doctrine. Key differentiators from ceiling finish (ceiling line cut-in ownership, faster wall rates, trim masking ownership) are correctly implemented. All PaintScope keys exist in catalog. Spray/backroll coupling correctly enforced. Task classification (binary vs qt_scaled vs qt_conditional) properly assigned. QT2 scope reduction correctly excludes inspection/repair module. Coat count rules by QT tier correctly implemented. One pending doctrine conflict (roller nap) is non-blocking and documented for human resolution. Ready to proceed to spec.json generation and human feedback gate.
